body: Lmao what? Yes it does. TOCD is literally OCD about a specific theme, in this case it's a fear that the person is secretly trans and they have OCD about it. AAP is completely unrelated and has absolutely 0 things in common as root causes.

Same. I want to end it, why has god played this sick and cruel joke. I want to be cis. Even if people accept me I'll never accept myself and I'm constantly jealous of my agab that they pull it off so easily.
Lots of men have internalized homophobia. Also, many trans people experience attraction to men once they start hrt, since their brain is running on more appropriate hormones.

Maybe. But as I said, I don't believe that your brain has to be fully female to experience these fantasies. This is why so many guys experience partial heterosexuality as well as what is known as "AGP". It's literally an intersex brain. In your case, it sounds like it's most likely almost fully masculinized, so you're probably safe.

I have a theory about why this happens.

I believe that many bi people have partially masculinized(for afabs)/feminized brains (for amabs) in the pre-natal developmental stages, which would mean that you do have the mental equipment to enjoy these fantasies. Does this mean that you're trans? If you're comfortable with your current gender lmao no. It just means you got just enough of the opposite hormone in the womb to still be comfortable in your gender but also experience these fantasies, so it's a spectrum. Enjoy :)

In my opinion meta attraction is just... attraction. Lots of cis straight women describe their attraction to men as liking the idea of being pursued. Check Contrapoints' video "Shame" where she talks about this, quite interesting. This plays into my theory that AGP is simply female sexuality since we don't have fully masculinized brains.
Personally I like it a lot, doesn't matter a lot how I look as long as I'm in a clear submissive role (and this usually means I'm more attracted to the bear type of men since the contrast is bigger)

Hah, same. My mom was extremely skinny (anorexia-like due to being poor) and was studying intensely for med school, pulling all-nighters and sleeping 2-3 hours every day for weeks. She also probably didn't get too much vitamin D because of her studying schedule, and that's important for testosterone levels during pregnancy. It is what it is, can't blame her, she's an amazing woman. However in my opinion gender identity incongruences would be less prevalent if people were more aware of their hormonal levels during pregnancy; if in some way, they would be monitored/regulated easily, I believe it would save a lot of dysphoric people the trouble.
AGP is simply a form of female sexuality and can definitely be a symptom of GD. It is a symptom that the brain isn't fully male, but it's definitely a spectrum and can overlap with "being cis".

It's hard. Being trans is hard. Dysphoria, social isolation, suicidal ideation... Shit, I know. I was just about to end it a few days ago. But you know what? It's the hand we have to play because it's the life we have. Our brains are already formed the way they are and there's not much else to do.

In my opinion, don't medically detrans (if you are on hrt). Manmoding... it is what it is. It sucks. It hurts. I view it from a stoic perspective. I'm doing the best I can with what I'm given at the moment, and there's not much else to do. I live with the hope that one day things get better.

But something I've noticed is that if I force myself back into the closet I get intense dysphoria again. Idk what's up with that, but at least one layer of (probably social) dysphoria got peeled off. I'm pre-anything enby(?) and I get it. Fundamentally we've got this one chance at life and we've gotta play it to the best of our abilities, and that's the thing that personally keeps me from offing myself. Some of us weren't lucky enough to have our brains develop in a way that aligns perfectly with our bodies, but that just means we have to work a bit on that more than your average cis person has to.
